paragraphs: Flood on wind farms: FEMA Hazus-MH 2.1 Table 7.9 whole-substation depth-damage table used exactly as published (0 to 10 ft, damage 0 to 0.15), linear between one-foot points. It names 1 part: GSU / substation (whole facility). Outside its scope: outage restoration, business interruption, curtailment, revenue and insurance, soft, sunk and non-physical costs (excluded from the physical base) and other hazards in the same event (tropical-cyclone wind, tornado); one event must not charge the same value twice. Kinds of damage it does not include: scour, erosion, saturated-soil support loss, debris impact and wave loading and flood duration (captured but has no effect on the result).

For this hazard the wind farm is split into 1 part: GSU / substation (whole facility). 14 further units are named but withheld — fw gsu switchgear, fw gsu transformer main, fw gsu transformer aux controls, fw gsu protection scada, fw gsu station service dc, fw gsu cable terminations, fw turbine base electrical, fw padmount stepup transformer, fw collection cable terminations, fw turbine foundation, fw civil access drainage, fw elevated turbine equipment, support fieldwork and support transport logistics — a stated 'not zero', not a curve. Parts of the plant's value with no curve yet: GSU parts as separate units: switchgear, main transformer, transformer auxiliaries and controls, protection and SCADA, station service and DC, cable terminations (withheld, not zero), turbine-base electrical and pad or turbine step-up transformers (withheld), collection cable joints and terminations (withheld), turbine foundation (needs a separate scour and erosion pathway) and civil access and drainage (needs a split), elevated turbine equipment: rotor, nacelle, tower (geometry-screened, not declared zero) and fieldwork and transport support (allocated once after repair scope; no fragility).

The damage ratio is a share of full direct replacement value of the same facility-level GSU/substation (not project TIV, not the mixed 72 USD/kW electrical row). The files state no plant-level dollar figure for this asset.

claims.text: Typical wind and solar generation facilities can use the same facility-level Plant GSU role and collection-bus-to-interconnection architecture.
claims.update_trigger: FERC configuration guidance or class scope changes.

claims.text: For future component-level records, a local water-depth bridge may use component vulnerable datum h_i=max(0,WSE-z_i_crit); this is not the model-v1 whole-substation runtime axis.
claims.locator: elevation/critical-depth method and canonical flood_solar axis
claims.update_trigger: A component record is validated or the assembly-axis contract changes.

claims.text: Asset label solar versus wind is not an intrinsic selector for materially identical equipment and delivered exposure.
claims.update_trigger: Evidence shows technology context changes intrinsic response after controls.

claims.text: Switchgear main transformer auxiliaries controls station service and terminations require separate failure-unit identities unless an adopted source explicitly supplies a whole-facility atom.
claims.locator: equipment categories, case endpoints, and Hazus Table 7.9 comments
claims.update_trigger: Claims/OEM data or reviewed NEMA CS 70006-2026 guidance change the decomposition.

claims.text: NERC shallow relay-room flooding demonstrates operational sensitivity but does not calibrate physical DR.
claims.locator: approximately 8 inches and 495 MW operational consequence
claims.update_trigger: A source publishes component disposition and cost for the event.

claims.text: FS_SWG remains a pinned component candidate but is not the adopted whole-substation curve and remains audit-only for flood_wind.
claims.update_trigger: Exact equipment applicability and economic validation pass.

claims.text: FS_XFMR cannot transfer directly because its datum/control semantics and main-transformer value denominator are mixed.
claims.update_trigger: A dependency-safe transformer state/cost model is validated.

claims.text: FS_SCADA and FS_CABLE are partial concept/mechanism matches only.
claims.update_trigger: Qualified equipment and value crosswalks pass.

claims.text: The CWER wind electrical value is one mixed 72 2023 USD/kW bucket and does not support a standalone 9% substation allocation.
claims.locator: land-based reference breakdown and local Wind_Map row 12
claims.update_trigger: Site/OEM/insured schedule supplies a complete non-overlapping value.

claims.text: Functional association or mapped generation-substation role does not prove project ownership or insured inclusion.
claims.locator: LGIA demarcation definitions and Hazard ownership audit
claims.update_trigger: Executed agreement, one-line, and value schedule resolve the boundary.

claims.text: Riverine pluvial and coastal sources may share a contact response only for the same delivered exposure and conditioner vector.
claims.update_trigger: Validated source-specific variants or equivalence tests pass.

claims.text: Scour erosion and saturated-soil support loss are separate from direct inundation contact.
claims.update_trigger: Qualified scour pathway is released.

claims.text: The legacy M3 anchored logistics are regression fixtures and contain a non-renormalized asymptote discrepancy.
claims.update_trigger: Legacy code is retired after pinned migration.

claims.text: Replacing Hazard M3 alone does not remove the M4 coastal hardcoded bypass.
claims.update_trigger: Consumer dual-read and bypass KAT pass.

claims.text: Missing ground/elevation data and synthetic centroid fallback cannot become dry or a priced substation.
claims.update_trigger: Observed component identity geometry and datum become available.

claims.text: Support fieldwork and transport are allocated once after direct damaged units and disposition are known.
claims.update_trigger: Claims-backed support allocation is approved.

claims.text: The model-v0.1 bounded negative remains valid for component-local state-to-disposition-to-same-unit-cost chains but is superseded at whole-substation grain by FW-S011.
claims.locator: bounded endpoint review plus Hazus-MH 2.1 Table 7.9 and Hazus 7.0 status
claims.update_trigger: Matched component evidence or a newer official Hazus status changes.

claims.text: Model v1.0 changes capability from universal numeric withholding to one conditional whole-substation scalar DR while every prior failure unit remains withheld.
claims.locator: proposed artifact capability declaration and evaluation contract
claims.update_trigger: Independent review or canonical promotion decision.

claims.text: FW_HAZUS_2_1_SUBSTATION_SCREENING_PWL exactly reproduces Table 7.9 ratios [0,.02,.04,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.12,.14,.15] at depths 0 through 10 ft and linearly interpolates only between knots.
claims.update_trigger: Source-table correction or independent transcription failure.

claims.text: The Hazus curve atom is one facility-level control-room cabling transformer and switchgear assembly with the full same-substation direct replacement value denominator.
claims.update_trigger: A source publishes dependency-safe component attribution.

claims.text: ESSL ESSM and ESSH publish identical Table 7.9 ordinates but substation_hazus_class remains a required no-default selector.
claims.update_trigger: New class-specific evidence or source revision.

claims.text: Numeric evaluation requires source_assumption_set_id=FEMA_HAZUS_MH_2_1_TABLE_7_9_UNPROTECTED_SUBSTATION and axis FLOOD_DEPTH_ABOVE_SUBSTATION_GRADE_FT_HAZUS.
claims.locator: source assumptions, proposed artifact selector, and evaluation contract
claims.update_trigger: A reviewed source adapter supersedes the gate.

claims.text: Hazus 7.0 lists electric-power substations as mapping-only and states that viewable default electric-power functions are disabled and produce no results.
claims.update_trigger: FEMA re-enables and documents validated electric-power loss functions.

claims.text: Numeric support is limited to water_quality_class=freshwater_non_contaminated and delivered_depth_basis=unprotected_or_internal_post_bypass_depth; protection is handled once in delivered depth.
claims.locator: source domain and proposed conditioner contract
claims.update_trigger: NEMA CS 70006-2026 and qualified water-quality or protection-response evidence are acquired and reviewed.

claims.text: The Hazus assembly representation and the six component GSU representations are mutually exclusive for both response and value.
claims.update_trigger: A dependency-safe decomposition explicitly replaces the assembly.

claims.text: The canonical screening evaluator emits DR; scenario loss is supported only with explicit same-substation value ownership and exposure checks.
claims.update_trigger: Value or cap-binding contract changes.

claims.text: NEMA's April 2026 publication register identifies the same-titled successor guide NEMA CS 70006-2026, so GD 1-2016 is historical and the current guide must be acquired and technically reviewed before canonical promotion.
claims.locator: FW-S013 Recently Published Documents, p. 5; FW-S002 sections 4.3 and 4.4
claims.update_trigger: NEMA CS 70006-2026 is acquired, registered, compared against FW-S002, and reviewed.
